name: Nested SMS: Master System -> Genesis
cli: brokendev.ps1 nested-everything sms2md <in.sms> <out.md> [-Profile <game id or file>] [-Feedback none|brokennes] [-Set key=value,...]
description: Ahead-of-time Z80 -> 68000 translation (static analysis + entry-point feedback from BrokenNes's SMS core + per-game profiles) with a small 68000 runtime that stands in for the SMS VDP, PSG, pads and Sega mapper. The output is a plain Genesis ROM: no SMS-mode reset, no Power Base Converter. Video back end B (Mode 5 translation) is built; back end A (keep the VDP in Mode 4) is a stub until a real console says Mode 4 works from Genesis mode.

settings.what: Video back end: mode5 = translate the SMS picture to Genesis Mode 5 (tiles converted, name table / sprites / colours translated); mode4 = leave the VDP in SMS Mode 4 and pass the game's writes through (STUB, needs the md-mode4-test answer from real hardware)

Pointer accesses: trace = the direct work-RAM path only where the dynamic pass saw nothing but work RAM, checked helpers elsewhere; trust_ram = direct everywhere (fast, breaks games that read ROM tables through pointers)
SMS 2-bit colour level -> Genesis 3-bit level (R, G and B)

Return-address prediction (shadow return stack on the 68000): off by default. On CTW it gained nothing measurable and 2 of 8 New Game starts stopped on a bad far-call target with it on (cause not found).

profiles: BrokenDev/projects/nested-sms2md/profiles/<game id>.json: settings, inputs (dynamic-pass scripts), entries [[bank, slot, pc]], idle_pc [z80 addresses of the game's wait-for-frame loop: lag = frames that never reached it], calls_keep_flags
